data.name: San Diego Parade of Lights
data.headline: December 14th & 21st, 2025
data.description:
**San Diego Parade of Lights**

Each December, the San Diego Bay Parade of Lights fills the harbor with holiday wonder, and this year’s “An Out of This World Christmas” theme is set to shine brighter than ever. **For the first time in 10 years, Sail San Diego is bringing back exclusive Parade of Lights trips** and spots are extremely limited. Join us on the water for an unforgettable holiday experience with family, friends, and guests under the glow of the season.

meeting_point.address: 2720 Shelter Island Drive San Diego, CA US 92106

data.what_is_included:
Upon Arrival:
* Build Your Own Ornament Station
* Hot Cocoa & Harbor Cheer Station (Regular or Spiked)

Onboard Sailboat:
* Blankets
* Complimentary Beers, 1 Bottle of White Wine, Sodas & Water
* Hand Warmers
data.what_to_bring: We have blankets on the boat but please be sure to wear warm clothing.
data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
We understand things happen and plans change, that's why we have the most flexible cancellation policy in the industry. Reservations are 100% refundable if canceled outside of 72 hours of the date of the departure. 

**Weather Policy**
Sail San Diego does not operate in unsafe weather conditions, but a light rain shower is not a deterrent. The Captain will assess the weather and should the Captain determine that the conditions are unsafe to run the charter, the charter may be rescheduled or it will be canceled.

- If a trip is canceled by Sail San Diego for any reason, you will have the option of receiving store credit for a future trip or receiving a full refund.
data.check_in_details:
**When is it?**
***Sunday, December 14, 2025 from 5pm-7:30pm***

***Sunday, December 21, 2025 from 5pm-7:30pm***

**How long is the Sail?**
Join us early for pre-departure drinks and our ornament station from 4:00–4:45 PM, then we’ll cast off promptly at 5:00 PM.
Enjoy a 2.5-hour cruise, returning at approximately 7:30 PM.
